sources.title: Surfnerd spot guide: Shark Pit - Marin

tide: works at Low, Mid, High (surfnerd); Good surf at all stages of the tide. (surf-forecast)
hazards: Watch out for sharks, rips and rocks. (surf-forecast)
notes: surfnerd pin 0.1 km from ours. surf-forecast pin 0.5 km from ours (its coordinates are given to 0.01°). surf-forecast: "exposed beach". Types differ (surfnerd Rivermouth; surf-forecast exposed beach); the non-beach type is recorded.
